title: 台阶上的树影
goal: 统一地面转折与投影关系
scene: Two broad warm beige outdoor stone steps viewed from slightly above at an angle. One potted shrub sits on upper landing far right, simple ochre pot with readable elliptical rim and tapered body; yellow-olive foliage. Broad coherent warm-gray leaf-shaped shadow falls diagonally across landing AND over step risers with bends following planes. Keep shadow simplified in 2-3 connected masses, no intricate lace shadows. White background and few plant strokes. No door, house or extra pots.
decision: 先确定台阶平面，再让投影随转折改变，不用投影遮盖结构错误
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper.
